en.title: Turn Notion specs into tasks
en.description: Translate a product specification into an implementation plan and trackable tasks.
tasks: Translate a product specification into an implementation plan and trackable tasks.
prerequisites: Notion MCP with access to the specification and the destination task database.
en.example: Use notion-spec-to-implementation. Break this feature spec into one- or two-day tasks with acceptance criteria and dependencies.
en.expectedResult: A linked implementation plan, task breakdown, and progress fields.
limitations: Database schemas vary; review mappings and task creation before writing to Notion.
Upstream Codex connector setup commands are version-specific; use your current host’s Notion connection settings.

zh.title: 将 Notion 需求拆成任务
zh.description: 将产品需求转为实施计划和可跟踪任务。
tasks: 将产品需求转为实施计划和可跟踪任务。
prerequisites: Notion MCP 可访问需求页及目标任务数据库。
zh.example: 请使用 notion-spec-to-implementation：把这个功能需求拆成一至两天的任务，写明验收标准与依赖。
zh.expectedResult: 关联需求的实施计划、任务拆分和进度字段。
limitations: 数据库结构各异，写入前需核对字段映射和任务内容。
上游 Codex 连接配置命令有版本差异，请使用当前宿主的 Notion 连接设置。
